canonical_identity_policy.removal_identity: resolved through the bounded active instance index
canonical_identity_policy.unknown_removal_policy: emit a data-quality gap and never guess a static effect ID
canonical_identity_policy.payload_free_layer_policy: retain the exact stacked or consumed lifecycle state with an absent resulting stack count

consumed_stack_semantics.decoder_behavior: BuffChange.layer is the post-change remaining stack count. A remove-layer event is emitted as consumed but remains active while that count is nonzero; only zero or a final remove event closes the instance.
consumed_stack_semantics.evidence_policy: Every intermediate count remains available to formulas and recounts. Consumed never means that an HP-dependent effect or its attribute surface may be discarded.

hp_dependent_surface_proof.fixed_point_transition: With intermediate MaxHP 11321 fixed at 569116, moving raw extra percent 11325 from 5440 to 4987 changes final MaxHP by exactly floor(569116*5440/10000)-floor(569116*4987/10000)=25781.
hp_dependent_surface_proof.localized_behavior_evidence: Current-build Shield Knight talent text explicitly names Judgment, Zeal Crusade, and Radiance as healing or damage-reduction behaviors based on MaxHP. That text establishes which mechanics require the preserved HP surface, while packet attributes and damage rows remain the authority for numeric formulas.
hp_dependent_surface_proof.unresolved_without_guessing: Other simultaneous modifiers produce additional observed stack/value cohorts, and the localized +2% per-stack text does not equal the isolated live 453-or-454 basis-point transition. Those cohorts remain visible; they are not collapsed into one guessed scalar.
hp_dependent_surface_proof.runtime_cost: The stack-to-attribute proof is generated offline from canonical rlogs. The live decoder only emits the already-required status and attribute events.

runtime_policy.presentation_join: effect names and icons are joined after numeric event reduction
